title: 48 s pop song with lyrics Muse wrote
prompt: Bright indie-pop song, warm female lead vocal, clear diction, piano and plucked guitar, punchy drums from the chorus, hopeful and cinematic.
lyrics:

Midnight window, paper sky
Pencil moons are passing by
Every line you leave behind

Draw me in, draw me in tonight
Ink and neon, black and white
Every beat a brush of light
Draw me in, draw me in tonight
